name: Circuit Chakula
source:
In this world, where technology and tradition blend seamlessly in a vibrant, futuristic African metropolis. Play a night repairman working in the tallest commercial building(Kubwa Kulu), who is ever ready to listen to the customers: human, humanoid, hologram and alien.

- Meet all sorts of interesting customers with their own quirky stories ‍‍‍ ️ 
- Fix their broken devices with unique and calming puzzles  
- Make impactful choices that affect the lives of your customers, maybe the world! 
- Groove to chill afro lo-fi beats wherever you go 

Made by an upcoming African studio Mykiyi Entertainment, the game was inspired by Coffee talk and VA-11 Hall-A with Afro-futursitic themes

[From [url=https://mykiyi.itch.io/circuit-chakula] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个充满活力、未来主义的非洲大都市中，技术与传统无缝融合。扮演一名在最高的商业建筑（Kubwa Kulu）工作的夜间修理工，他随时准备倾听客户的声音：人类、类人生物、全息图和外星人。

- 结识各种有趣的顾客，有他们自己的离奇故事‍‍‍️ 
- 通过独特且令人平静的谜题修复损坏的设备  
- 做出有影响力的选择，影响客户的生活，甚至影响整个世界！
- 无论你身在何处，都可以聆听非洲低保真音乐的节奏 

该游戏由即将成立的非洲工作室Mykiyi Entertainment制作，灵感来自Coffee talk和VA-11 Hall-A的非洲未来主题

[来自[url=https://mykiyi.itch.io/circuit-chakula] itch.io[/url]]
